messages:
nate: Heads-up: customer reported quota exhaustion on project X but console shows traffic billed to org. Might be routing using org-affinity when SA token has no project claim.
sofia: saw a few traces like that. new routing policy prefers `org_affinity` for missing claims which affects quota attribution.
maria: can we avoid changing routing behavior? For billing/telemetry we can infer a hint, but routing decisions must remain conservative.
kai: agreed. security+privacy: any inferred project hints must be telemetry-only and scrubbed, cannot affect auth or routing.
sofia: plan: emit `auth.inferred_project` as a sampled event only (1% start), add `quota.attribution.fallback` metric, and keep routing unchanged.
nate: console: add an investigation card on project billing page showing sampled hints and a link to a reconcile job for SEs. Mark the card behind a feature flag.
maria: UI will show confidence and sample id; reconcile will be dry-run by default.
ops-bot: canary deploy queued: auth-service@canary -> routing-proxy@stable (1% sampling). Monitor `quota.attribution.fallback`.
kai: I'll start privacy review and confirm retention/scrubbing rules.
sofia: creating GH PR for sampler + metric + debug toggle `auth.debug_attribution_hint` (audited).
nate: thanks. action items: GH issue + privacy (kai), sampler PR (sofia), console card PR (maria), canary monitor (ops).
